title: Creamy Chicken Sausage & Spinach Egg Bake

ingredients.raw: 12 ounces chicken sausages, sliced into rounds
ingredients.name: chicken sausages

ingredients.raw: 5 ounces fresh baby spinach (or 10 ounces frozen spinach, thawed and drained)
ingredients.name: baby spinach

ingredients.raw: 4 ounces cream cheese, cut into tiny pieces
ingredients.name: cream cheese

ingredients.raw: 8 ounces white Cheddar cheese, shredded (about 2 cups), divided
ingredients.name: white cheddar cheese

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 275°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sausage and bell pepper; cook until sausage is browned and pepper is softened, about 6-7 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted or heated through; season with salt and pepper.
Whisk together eggs, milk, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes.
Spread sausage mixture in the prepared baking dish.
Scatter cream cheese pieces and sprinkle 1.5 cups Cheddar over the mixture.
Pour egg mixture over everything; top with remaining 0.5 cup Cheddar.
Bake 1 hour until center is set and top is golden brown.
Cool 5 minutes before slicing and serving warm.
